home.stepMultiRead: AI finding and reading each ticket
home.heading: Snap your ticket, check instantly
home.subtitle: Put the ticket in the frame and tap capture — we read the number, province and date and check it for you.
home.multiHint: Lay out up to 10 tickets without overlapping, with each ticket's number, province and date clearly visible.
home.tipLight: Good lighting, avoid shadows and glare
home.tipFrame: Shoot straight on, ticket fully inside the frame
home.tipFocus: Focus on the 6-digit number and the date line

off.title: Check tickets with your camera
off.body: Tap Turn on camera, then choose Allow when the browser asks. The camera is only used to photograph tickets.

denied.title: Camera access blocked
denied.body: Tap Try again and choose Allow. If no prompt appears, tap the icon next to the web address and enable Camera — or pick an existing ticket photo.

error.title: Couldn't open the camera
error.body: This device has no camera, or another app is using it. You can pick an existing ticket photo instead.

camera.alignHint: Center the ticket in the frame

upload.title: Choose a ticket photo
upload.hintMobile: Photo library or take one with your camera
upload.hintDesktop: or drag and drop a photo here

processing.verySlow: The network is a bit slow, still processing. You can wait a little longer or cancel and try again.
processing.slow: Still processing, this usually takes 5–10 seconds…

feedback.tipNumber: capture the 6 digits clearly, avoid blur/glare
feedback.title: Automatic reading result
feedback.filledNone: Couldn't fill in any more fields
feedback.localReview: Ticket number is certain — no AI re-read needed, just check the flagged fields
feedback.localExpired: Ticket has expired — no AI re-read needed
feedback.cloudFailed: (AI didn't respond in time — using server result)
feedback.cloudOnly: AI read the photo directly (no server-side OCR)
feedback.cloudOnlyFailed: AI didn't respond — please fill in below
feedback.missingTip1: You can fill it in below, or
feedback.missingTip2: : good lighting, straight on (no tilt), no shadows/glare, focus on the numbers and text.

confirm.unsure: Not sure about this — check it against the ticket
confirm.heading: Double-check your ticket
confirm.subtitle: Fix anything that was misread, then tap Check now.
confirm.expiredBody: : more than {{days}} days have passed since the draw (claim deadline was {{deadline}}).

result.editWrong: Wrong number, province or date? Edit
result.noDataBody: We haven't loaded the results for {{province}} on {{date}} yet. Check the date/province, or try again in a few minutes —
result.noDataBold: we can't tell yet whether the ticket won
result.alarmBody: We know your IP address, send us a 5% cut, quick! 😏
result.disclaimer: Results are read by AI and may contain errors. We are not responsible if you throw away your ticket.

multi.emptyTitle: No tickets found in the photo
multi.emptyBody: Retake a clearer photo, with tickets laid out neatly and not covering each other's numbers.
multi.pendingHint: {{count}} ticket(s) not read with certainty — tap to review and check
multi.heading: Results for {{count}} tickets
multi.subtitle: Tap a ticket to see details or fix it if it was misread.

scratch.label: 🪙 Scratch to see the result
scratch.hint: Swipe your finger or drag the mouse here
